slides.subtitle: Set up one Claude Project in about 15 minutes, step by step.

slides.label: 1. Create the project
slides.detail: Open Claude, choose Projects in the left-hand menu, then create a new project. Name it after one job, such as Customer emails.
slides.start: One project per job, not one for the whole business.

slides.label: 2. Let Claude write the briefing
slides.detail: In a normal chat, paste: I want to set up a Claude Project for answering customer emails. Ask me up to eight questions, one at a time, then write a briefing of no more than 300 words.
slides.start: Answer the questions, then copy the briefing.

slides.label: 3. Paste it into the instructions
slides.detail: Inside the project, find the option to set project instructions and paste the briefing in. Every chat in the project will follow it.
slides.start: Keep it short. 200 to 300 words is plenty.

slides.label: 4. Add two or three files
slides.detail: Upload your price list, your FAQ and a few real replies you were pleased with. Files are available to every chat in the project.
slides.start: Remove customer names and addresses first.

slides.label: 5. Test it
slides.detail: Open a new chat in the project and ask: A customer wants a quote by Friday and we are booked until Monday. Write a reply.
slides.start: If it misses, fix the instructions, not the chat.

slides.label: What it could give back
slides.detail: Five minutes a day re-explaining is 25 minutes a week. Over 48 weeks that is 20 hours. Illustrative, so time your own week.
slides.start: Start with the job that eats the most time.

slides.label: One thing to watch
slides.detail: Plan limits change and Anthropic's pages do not all agree. Check what your own account offers before you rely on a feature.
slides.start: Free accounts are listed as up to five projects.
